[!linux] [!darwin] skip # no pty support

# legacy.age is passphrase-encrypted ("password") with a scrypt work factor
# of 2^11, above the test-only default maximum of 2^10 set by TestMain.

# decrypt a legacy high work factor file, confirming the prompt
ttyin confirm
age -d legacy.age
ttyout 'Decrypt anyway'
stderr 'high scrypt work factor'
cmp stdout input

# declining the prompt refuses to decrypt
ttyin decline
! age -d legacy.age
stderr 'scrypt work factor too large: 11'

# files beyond the absolute maximum work factor are always rejected
ttyin confirm
! age -d crafted.age
stderr 'scrypt work factor too large: 31'
! ttyout 'Decrypt anyway'

-- confirm --
y
password
-- decline --
n
-- input --
test
-- legacy.age --
